items.title: Mrs. P. Thomas Agnes Brown Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: That doesn't look like Johnny. He's put on weight, but Johnny biased off him.

ctx.x: And Tom is next to him on trombone. That doesn't look like Johnny. He's put on weight, but Johnny biased off him. Leo Addy is on drums. I recognize him. You do? Now, the banjo I'm not sure about.
